course_name_original: Gaz Türbinli Motorların Tasarım Temelleri (Sektör Dersi)
course_name_en: Design Principles of Gas Turbine Engines (Industry Course)

learning_outcomes.text: Provides information on engine types, gas turbine types, areas of use, and applications.
Provides information on basic thermodynamics, ideal and real cycles.
Provides information on turbojet cycle design, compressor and turbine components, and their performance.
Examines engine characteristics and dimensionless parameters.
Examines compressor instability in transient operations.

syllabus_topics: Introduction to Gas Turbines: Engine Types and Uses, Gas Turbine Types and Applications
Aeronautical Applications: Gas Turbine Applications, Aircraft Performance, Thrust, Propulsive & Thermal Efficiency
Steady Flow Equations, Compressible Flow Equations, Adiabatic Component Efficiencies
Thermodynamic Cycles: Ideal Cycle, Real Cycle
Transient Operations: Basic Theory, Thermal Effects, Control
Transient Operations: Compressor Instabilities, Stall Types, Surge
assessment_rules: Midterm studies contribute 50% to the overall grade and consist of a midterm exam (50%), two quizzes (20% each), and one homework (10%). The final grade is determined by the final exam (50%) and the in-year success (50%).
